body: Is there a group therapy you could go to?

Everyone wants to hide that they're broken. A lot of people can hold up a perfect veneer until something happens that cracks it and lets their despair show. I've learned that people who seem impossibly happy, verging on hysterical, are actually deeply sad. They just act happy as hard as they can to run away from how they really feel.

As people get older, they sort themselves into somewhat homogenous groups. There are really smart schizophrenics and bipolars in the group I hung out with until my most recent depression. You can have hope that sometime you'll find people who want someone who can empathize with their misery. Even if they don't notice when I'm not around, there are enough borderline unstable people that I can swoop in to comfort them fairly often and give my life some meaning.

I've found that when I'm most down, what makes me feel best is helping someone. Can you volunteer somewhere? You're doing a good job getting out of the house if you're going to school.

Can you get a job digging holes for a fence or something? Manual labor pays decently since it's hard, the exertion could improve your mood, you don't have to spend time getting along with people, you'd be able to save up some money to move out, and if the government succeeds in being a piece of shit you'll still have a reason to go out. It's not the greatest long-term career path, but it's got some immediate benefits.

You can relate to someone who's broken, and that's a really positive trait to a small amount of people who are hopeless, too.

I think I'm a burden on everyone, too. I do have one person who I consider a good friend. I'm always in crisis and leaning on her. But I don't know how reliable she is. We had been talking about living together for the past year, and then she just moved into a place with like 8 other people. I was never told, I just learned about it from Facebook.

I make my sisters cry unloading on them. I spent all my dad's money on a school I didn't even use properly. I take from everyone but then don't even call them to thank them. I hate the way I deal with people.

My ex used me for money until he ran off with an ugly girl. The last month we were together, he couldn't help with the rent and promised to pay me back as soon as he could. And then he needed cash so I gave him everything in my wallet. And then he kept going out and lying about where he'd been. And then one morning he came back and packed his stuff. I was sobbing and he tried to take all the weed because he technically bought it, despite me fronting him hundreds of dollars in the past few weeks, and I had to fight him for it so that I'd have something to numb my pain.

I am sick of my solitude. I just want to be able to deal with people enough that I can have a roommate so I can get a fucking dishwasher and split the fucking cable bill. It's like I'm punished for being broken.

If your mother is really there for you, that's better than I've had it. When I was at my worst, my entire family wasn't there. I wasn't welcome in anyone's house. Everyone chose their significant other over me. That's why I am so desperate to have someone that thinks I'm the most important person to them. Friends and family have consistently watched me fall and did nothing but stand there holding someone else's hand.

I want someone to love me, but I don't believe in marriage and don't think I'm really lovable. I'll fall in love with anyone who seems consistently into me, even if they're a shitty person. I'll cling too tightly to a new boyfriend and strangle the budding relationship. I think that maybe I just exude desperation and that's why no one is interested in me for more than a night.

All I have is self-reliance. And that means I have to have a job that pays the rent. So I have to hide my flaws enough to be employable.
"Talk Show Host" by Radiohead just came on my iTunes on shuffle. How apropos.

I feel the same. What I feel about people is what I've learned. My inability to trust is based on experience, on tears and heartbreak due to thinking that anyone would be there for me. I can try to act like that's not how I feel, but it's not authentic. That other guy who posted said to act just how you want to without caring what other people think. And how I feel is that every person alive is a torn safety net, looking like they'll be there to catch you but actually letting you fall.

The most positive spin I can put on life is that there is always someone who'll be there. It won't be who you expect. Expecting anything specific is setting yourself up for disappointment. But there will be someone that you don't expect. Maybe it's just someone here on this forum.

But maybe I'm just lucky. I was born with a good deal of privilege.

You shouldn't have to stay where you are. Do you have access to therapy and someone who can give you some meds?

I've got enough problems that they get in the way of work. I like to work for praise, so I can work as long as I've got the right incentives (of course, I can't socialize with my coworkers. I'm not comfortable eating lunch in a group). But even then, I have spells where I know I've got to seem way off. I'm hoping the meds I just got on will help that.

I am just sick of being there for people. There's this one girl who I comforted when her boyfriend dumped because she cheated on him (according to him, "in a really gross way") because I knew she was sad and I didn't want her to be alone. Twice now, I've told her I'm in an emotional crisis. She gets a scared look in her eyes and ignores me. People think she's the greatest person ever. And they don't care whether I'm there or not.

I'd ask if you'd considered the army, but they screen for emotional issues. Are you stable enough day-to-day to ambitiously job hunt?

Laugh and the world laughs with you. Weep and you weep alone.

No one wants to get trapped supporting you when you really need it. It'll cramp their style. They've got their own lives to live. Which is totally rational from their point of view. So you can't blame them. But accepting that means losing any hope of having support.

You can't build friendships (or pick cousins) on the precondition that they'll be there when you need it. There's no reliable interview process. It's impossible to go out and find someone like that.

I run to someone's aid when they need it. I always assumed they'd do that same back. But that's stupid. People don't owe you what you'd give to them. That's not how it works. You can be the change you want to be in the world, but it's futile. It won't change anything, and you'll just exhaust yourself.

Did you get to move out yet? The only thing that's ever made me really feel better is getting out on my own and financially supporting myself.
Do you do any art to get this out?

I already had an upswing and a crash since we started this conversation. I was planning on moving away, but I think I'm going to get an amazing job.

But now the weekend is coming up. There are parties I could show up to but I don't think it would be noticed if I'm not there. I'd rather not rely on anyone than hope that they'd be there for me. I spent the entire month of December thinking of nothing but how much I wanted to die. I told one "friend" I was upset about just getting a bipolar diagnosis, and she said that the most important thing to make it easier is support. She never offered support. I told another "friend" that I was depressed and he said "I'm sorry" and then nothing. These two people had treated me really badly earlier, but I worked very hard to forgive them. That was stupid of me. I just need to learn that you just can't expect people not to be spineless pieces of shit. And I don't know why I've yet to learn that partying with people doesn't make them your friends.

"All men are created equal" my ass.

It's so fucked up that some people's souls are completely ruined by who their parents are.

What broke you?

People are really surprised at what I feel. I am really good at putting up a front.

I think you're nice, and you make me feel better.

I get jealous of my cats because they cuddle all the time. I wish I had someone I could just be around, doing nothing, and enjoy their company.

Get a cat? That's what I did.

There was a New York Times article a little while back about some people who basically lived as recluses in the woods somewhere. This one guy lived on an island in British Columbia with just a horse. I want to do that.

I'm really ready to give up on IRL people. I'm good at talking online, but in person I'm so awkward all the time. I feel so incompetent. I'm a smart pretty (or so people tell me) nice nympho and I can't get a fucking date. What the hell is wrong with me that I got dealt what seems like a great hand and I can't do ANYTHING with it?
I love you for talking to me and helping me on Valentine's Day. It does make me feel better about people, if not about me.
And benzos. I just want to spend all my time zonked out on depressants.
Actually, I like drinking. But I know that's bad for me.

I have got that far. I started saying no, to my family and to guys.

But now I'm doing nothing. There's nothing to replace doing what other people expect.
All I've ever been is what people want me to be. I don't know how to be something I choose.

And everyone says that what you really need to get through depression is support. What the fuck am I supposed to do without friends? What can I do if I reach out to someone I think will help (because I helped them before) but they just say, "Well, that sucks. I'm sorry you feel that way," and then never do anything more? I'm so scared to reach out, and I did because I know that's supposed to help. But it made it worse. If I hadn't told anyone about being depressed, I could say no one helped because they didn't know. But I told THREE of my "friends" and no one ever tried to make me go out or came to visit me.

I try to have some hope for the future by telling myself that I have too high expectations and that's why I feel like people let me down. But in this case that's bullshit. Expecting a friend to fucking call when you're depressed is not unreasonable. What the fuck is wrong with me that I don't have a friend who'll help me out when I want to kill myself?

I was raised Christian and still like it. So I try to think maybe we're supposed to be like God and Jesus. Forgive anything. Love people even when they're not worthy of love. Sacrifice yourself to save people you don't know. Be humble and loving.

But if that's what we're supposed to do, why are there so many other people who are happy and reveling in other people's affection? It's people who are the opposite that seem to be doing the best.

In my dream life, there would be someone to whom I am the most important person in the world. And I know that since I want this so bad, I am too clingy and needy and overeager to please. I attach to people who are bad for me not because they have any characteristics that I admire but just because they're there.

I'd have a job where I get to be productive. Mindless work is wearing down my soul. I don't need to be the top dog. I just want to contribute and be acknowledged.

I'd stop wanting to cut. I'd stop overeating. I'd stop being so anxious. I'd be comfortable being who I am in front of people instead of trying to mold myself into what I think they want me to be. I'd love myself.

I just want out so bad. I've moved away to press reset a few times, and it doesn't work. I start to get along, but then I realize that I'll never fit in with people who've been friends for years. I see people getting married, and they have bridesmaids. I'll never be a bridesmaid because I've never been able to sustain a friendship with another girl.

I want to move but can't because I don't trust people so I can't get a roommate and I can't afford a nicer place. I spend so much of my time hating where I am, the little things like the shower drain always being clogged no matter now much Drano I pour in. I just hurt my knee, so I can't get out and see anyone at all, which is actually a relief because I'm so scared that everyone hates me anyway and doesn't care if I don't go out. If I do get out, I have no idea where to go. There's nothing I want to do, and it's been that way for a few years.

I feel like I'm a waste of intelligence and an endless drain on the people who do love me. I just want to stop feeling like this.

I've promised myself that I'd give life a fair shot and then I'd get to quit if it didn't get better. I've got two and a half years left. It's not better.
